newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ZAG Industries cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ZAG Industries cut.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said it downgraded ZAG Industries Inc to outperform from buy.
-- said longer term, believes ZAG should be able to maintain solid 25 percent top line and earnings per share growth through new product introductions and greater penetration at mass merchants.

-- cut second quarter 1997 earnings outlook to $0.10 a share from $0.23 a share. Cut the 1997 estimate to $0.76 a share from $1.13 a share and trimmed the 1998 estimate to $1.03 a share from $1.50 a share.
